title: BREACH BY A THOUSAND LEAKS: UNSAFE INFORMATION LEAKAGE IN ‘SAFE’ AI RESPONSES
reasoning: The paper focuses on an information-theoretic framework for evaluating safety and hazardous knowledge leakage in LLMs. It defines and measures 'impermissible information gain' related to biological, chemical, and cybernetic threats, as well as social engineering, rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral philosophies, or ethics.
